prefill.quotation: Grasslands declined by 2,815 ha (27%) to 7,667 ha (19%), contracting by 128 ha/yr, especially near settlements and in the north. Overgrown areas rose by 1,646 ha (47%), reaching 5,125 ha (13%), with an average gain of 75 ha/yr, dispersed across the region.
prefill.comment: This is the grassland and overgrowth change in the Natura 2000 site Kras from the national Land Use database (MKGP), 2002-2024. We re-derive it from the same database's public archive snapshots with open code, compare shares and relative change (the authors' study-area polygon is not published), and ask whether open EU-wide layers (CORINE, HRL Grassland, CLC+ Backbone) detect a change of this size. They do not: CORINE change layers show 7.4 ha lost from grassland classes 2000-2018 inside SAC SI3000276.

prefill.aida: Between 2002 and 2024, the area of grassland in the Natura 2000 site Kras in Slovenia declined by about a quarter.

prefill.label: Grassland decline in Natura 2000 site Kras, 2002-2024, national Land Use database
Replication with open code and public archive snapshots: grassland and overgrowth change in Natura 2000 site Kras, 2002-2024
prefill.scope: The direction and relative size of change 2002-2024 in three land-use classes of the paper's Table 2 (grasslands, overgrown areas, forest) in the Natura 2000 site Kras, and their shares of the site in 2002, 2012 and 2024. Out of scope: the socioeconomic models (GLMs), the TerrSet change-process and spatial-trend analyses, and absolute hectares, which depend on a study-area polygon that is not published.
prefill.methodology: Public snapshots of the Slovenian Land Use database (MKGP RABA) from https://rkg.gov.si/arhiv/RABA/ (2002: RABA_2002_SHP.ZIP; 2012: RABA_2012_12_04.RAR; 2024: RABA_2024_06_30.zip) are read with open Python code (pipeline/raba.py), reprojected from D48/GK (EPSG:3912, up to 2018) to D96/TM (EPSG:3794), clipped to the Natura 2000 boundary from the EEA end-2024 release, and reclassified into the paper's classes following its Table 1 (config/validation/reclass.csv). Areas are exact vector areas. Shares and relative change 2002-2024 are compared with the paper's Table 2. The same code reports the latest month-end snapshot as a monitoring service.
prefill.deviation: 1) Study area: SAC SI3000276 Kras from the EEA (48,042 ha) instead of the authors' ZRSVN polygon of the Natura 2000 part of the Kras plateau (~40,120 ha, unpublished); the SAC's northern part (22,280 ha) is also reported. 2) Exact vector areas instead of 5 m rasterisation. 3) The paper does not say which version of each year it used; we use the versions named above. 4) The 2002 meadow codes 1310 and 1322, absent from the paper's Table 1, are mapped to grasslands. 5) Python instead of QGIS / TerrSet / Excel.

Public part (may be published): open EU-wide layers inside SAC SI3000276 detect far less change: CORINE change layers 7.4 ha lost from natural grasslands and pastures 2000-2018 (all pastures to mineral extraction, 2000-2006); HRL Grassland 2015-2018 gain and loss classes are labelled unverified by the product; CLC+ Backbone 2018 and 2021 are separate classifications (permanent herbaceous 11,203.1 and 11,273.4 ha). Source: results/summary.json.
prefill.limitations: Different study area from the paper (its ZRSVN polygon is not published), so absolute hectares are not comparable; shares and relative change are. RABA is updated from orthophoto interpretation on roughly a three-year cycle and its methodology changed over time (classes, minimum mapping unit, interpretation rules; RABA_Read_me.pdf), so part of any change between versions may be methodological; the paper says the same of its extreme values. The date of last change or review (D_OD) appears bulk-updated in recent versions and cannot show how current each area is. Not reviewed by an ecologist.
